maximum_depth_rule: All 543 canonical Phase 9 Reviewed statements are retained exactly once with their registered document, PDF location, raw text, tokens, unit, scope, operator, and unresolved comparability boundary.
version_boundary: The long-term vision, 2023 to 2026 action plan, five programs, indicator guide values, fiscal 2023 and 2024 actions, individual projects, and prior-plan overview and full editions remain separate versions and layers.
non_goals: Do not infer records from the two registered documents with zero reviewed rows.
Do not add all 544 candidate rows as independent canonical outcomes or ignore the one-record overlap boundary.
Do not reinterpret guide values as mandatory targets or merge project costs, actions, baselines, and prior-plan indicators.
Do not calculate policy achievement, causality, or cross-prefecture ranking.
